mapper.sql: j.id, j.source_id, j.content_version_id, j.base_evaluation_id, j.rule_release_id, j.policy_id, j.batch_id, j.set_id, j.generation, j.expected_source_version, j.expected_attachment_version, j.job_status_code, j.attempt_count, j.next_attempt_at, j.lease_token, j.lease_expires_at, j.error_code, j.idempotency_key, j.request_hash, j.execution_snapshot_json::text AS execution_snapshot_json, j.download_budget_bytes, j.reserved_download_bytes, j.row_version, j.operation_code,j.reference_set_id,j.requested_by

SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.provider_code, s.data_purpose_code, s.semantic_status_code, e.id AS base_evaluation_id, e.content_version_id, e.rule_release_id, e.title_stage_code, s.classification_row_version AS source_version, s.attachment_row_version AS attachment_version, s.is_attachment_review_required, s.attachment_policy_id, s.current_attachment_evaluation_id FROM announcement_source_snapshots s LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id = s.id AND e.is_current WHERE s.id = #{sourceId}
mapper.select: -- 외부 요청 전에 source/base/lease를 검증한다. 원문 title/body 또는 인증값은 읽지 않는다. SELECT s.provider_code,s.provider_notice_id,s.source_url,l.public_code AS local_source_code,l.parser_profile_code FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id AND s.classification_row_version=j.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=j.expected_attachment_version JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.id=j.base_evaluation_id AND e.source_id=s.id AND e.content_version_id=j.content_version_id AND e.rule_release_id=j.rule_release_id AND e.is_current LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_sources l ON l.id=s.local_government_source_id WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED') AND (s.provider_code<>'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' OR (l.is_enabled AND l.deleted_at IS NULL)) AND (j.batch_id IS NULL OR attachment_batch_job_input_unchanged(j.id))
mapper.sql: -- 작업은 게시 당시 정책을 유지한다. 현재 ACTIVE 규칙의 OFF 정책/배치 중지는 추가 요청을 막는다. j.operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policies p WHERE p.id=j.policy_id AND p.policy_status_code IN ('ACTIVE','RETIRED') AND p.mode_code<>'OFF') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policies control JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases active_rule ON active_rule.id=control.rule_release_id WHERE control.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' AND control.mode_code='OFF' AND active_rule.release_status_code='ACTIVE') AND (j.batch_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_batches b WHERE b.id=j.batch_id AND b.batch_status_code IN ('COLLECTION_PENDING','COLLECTING') AND (b.scope_item_count IS NULL OR (b.collection_started_at IS NOT NULL AND b.collection_approval_hash IS NOT NULL AND attachment_batch_job_input_unchanged(j.id))))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.id=j.base_evaluation_id AND e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current AND e.content_version_id=j.content_version_id AND e.rule_release_id=j.rule_release_id LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_sources l ON l.id=s.local_government_source_id WHERE s.id=j.source_id AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED') AND e.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND s.classification_row_version=j.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=j.expected_attachment_version AND (s.provider_code<>'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' OR (l.is_enabled AND l.deleted_at IS NULL)))
mapper.select: -- lease와 실행 조건을 매 요청 직전에 재확인한다. HTTP 동안 잠금을 유지하지 않는다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND )
-- 변경된 출처/검수를 무한 재대기하지 않고 claim 시 CONFLICT로 집계한다. SELECT attachment_batch_job_input_unchanged(#{jobId})
mapper.update: -- source version이 그대로여도 출처 연결/기존 검수가 달라졌다면 정확한 충돌 사유로 종료한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code='CONFLICT',error_code='FROZEN_INPUT_CHANGED',lease_token=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,next_attempt_at=NULL,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND job_status_code='RUNNING' AND batch_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()

-- 자원 경합만으로 시도를 소진하지 않는다. 이미 통신한 시도와 누적 byte는 되돌리지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code=CASE WHEN #{requestStarted} AND attempt_count>=3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRY_WAIT' END, error_code='EXECUTION_DEFERRED', lease_token=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, attempt_count=CASE WHEN #{requestStarted} THEN attempt_count ELSE GREATEST(attempt_count-1,0) END, next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN #{requestStarted} AND attempt_count>=3 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' END, row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND job_status_code='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: -- source 잠금 이후 호출한다. 만료된 lease의 결과 저장은 허용하지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE OF j

-- 예약은 source부터 잠근다. 기존 source 변경 경로와 잠금 순서를 유지한다.
FOR UPDATE OF s
-- claim은 job을 잠근 상태이므로 source를 다시 잠그지 않아 역순 교착을 피한다.

-- 예약 transaction 중 게시/퇴역과 경합하지 않도록 공유 잠금을 유지한다. SELECT p.id AS policy_id, p.policy_status_code, p.mode_code, p.rule_release_id, r.release_status_code, p.policy_hash, p.settings_json::text AS settings_json, p.profile_manifest_json::text AS profile_manifest_json, p.row_version FROM announcement_attachment_policies p JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id = p.rule_release_id WHERE p.id = #{policyId} FOR SHARE OF p, r

-- 임의 퇴역 정책 예약은 금지한다. 수집 시작 때 DB에 고정된 계획만 예외다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_collection_plans WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND policy_id=#{policyId} AND rule_release_id=#{ruleReleaseId} AND plan_status_code='FROZEN')

-- 새 원문의 최초 base와 동일 run이어야 한다. 기존/연결 원문에는 자동 ENFORCE를 적용하지 않는다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.source_id=s.id AND e.is_current WHERE s.id=#{sourceId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} AND s.classification_row_version=0 AND s.attachment_row_version=0 AND NOT s.is_attachment_review_required AND s.current_attachment_evaluation_id IS NULL AND s.attachment_policy_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links l WHERE l.source_id=s.id))
-- 예약 직전 확정 ID만 복구 근거로 보관한다. 검수 원문을 복사하지 않는다. SELECT id FROM announcement_source_attachment_confirmations WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND is_current
mapper.update: -- 같은 source transaction 안에서 pending 검수 보호를 연결한다. 자동 활성화하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET attachment_policy_id=#{policyId},is_attachment_review_required=true WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND attachment_row_version=#{attachmentVersion} AND NOT is_attachment_review_required AND attachment_policy_id IS NULL
mapper.select: -- source lock 아래에서만 호출하여 같은 입력의 generation을 직렬 증가시킨다. SELECT COALESCE(MAX(j.generation), 0) + 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.source_id = #{sourceId} AND j.content_version_id = #{contentVersionId} AND j.policy_id = #{policyId}
mapper.insert: -- 중복키 충돌은 원래 작업을 보존하며, 반환 건수를 검사하여 암묵적 범위 축소를 막는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_jobs ( id, source_id, content_version_id, base_evaluation_id, rule_release_id, policy_id, generation, expected_source_version, expected_attachment_version, job_status_code, idempotency_key, request_hash, execution_snapshot_json, download_budget_bytes,collection_run_id, previous_attachment_evaluation_id,previous_confirmation_id,previous_policy_id,previous_is_review_required, application_status_code,applied_attachment_version,operation_code,reference_set_id,requested_by,set_id ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{sourceId}, #{contentVersionId}, #{baseEvaluationId}, #{ruleReleaseId}, #{policyId}, #{generation}, #{expectedSourceVersion}, #{expectedAttachmentVersion}, 'PENDING', #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, CAST(#{executionSnapshotJson} AS jsonb), #{downloadBudgetBytes},#{collectionRunId}, #{previousEvaluationId},#{previousConfirmationId},#{previousPolicyId},#{previousReviewRequired}, CASE WHEN #{applyToSource} THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUESTED' END, CASE WHEN #{applyToSource} THEN #{expectedAttachmentVersion} ELSE NULL END, #{operationCode},#{referenceSetId},#{requestedBy},#{readySetId} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: -- 새 세대 예약부터 이전 첨부 판정을 현재 결과로 노출하지 않는다. base와 그 확정 태그는 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET attachment_row_version = attachment_row_version + 1, current_attachment_evaluation_id = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND attachment_row_version = #{expectedVersion}
-- source 잠금과 같은 transaction에서 포인터/current를 함께 해제하고 과거 판정은 보존한다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_evaluations SET is_current = false WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND is_current
-- 새 첨부 세대는 이전 첨부 확인을 승계하지 않는다. base 확인에는 영향을 주지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c SET is_current = false WHERE c.source_id = #{sourceId} AND c.is_current
mapper.select: -- 잠긴 후보는 건너뛰고 한 작업만 claim한다. scope preview/paused batch는 실행하지 않는다. WITH candidate AS ( SELECT q.id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs q JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=q.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=q.rule_release_id LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_batches b ON b.id = q.batch_id WHERE q.job_status_code IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND q.attempt_count < 3 AND (q.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR q.next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp()) AND q.execution_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL AND (q.set_id IS NOT NULL OR (p.policy_status_code IN ('ACTIVE','RETIRED') AND p.mode_code<>'OFF' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policies control JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases active_rule ON active_rule.id=control.rule_release_id WHERE control.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' AND control.mode_code='OFF' AND active_rule.release_status_code='ACTIVE'))) AND (q.batch_id IS NULL OR b.batch_status_code IN ('COLLECTION_PENDING', 'COLLECTING')) ORDER BY q.created_at, q.id FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs j SET job_status_code = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = j.attempt_count + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + #{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second', heartbeat_at = clock_timestamp(), next_attempt_at = NULL, row_version = j.row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM candidate c WHERE j.id = c.id RETURNING
mapper.update: -- 만료 회수는 최대 100개 단위로 처리하며 누적 예산과 불변 실행 입력은 유지한다. WITH expired AS ( SELECT id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() ORDER BY lease_expires_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100 ) UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs j SET job_status_code = CASE WHEN j.attempt_count < 3 THEN 'RETRY_WAIT' ELSE 'FAILED' END, error_code = 'WORKER_LEASE_EXPIRED', lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN j.attempt_count < 3 THEN clock_timestamp() + (CASE WHEN j.attempt_count = 1 THEN 60 ELSE 300 END) * interval '1 second' ELSE NULL END, row_version = j.row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM expired e WHERE j.id = e.id

-- 변경된 원문/검수 위에 오래된 작업 결과를 덮어쓰지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code = 'CONFLICT', error_code = 'SOURCE_VERSION_CHANGED', lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()

-- 만료된 lease를 heartbeat로 부활시키지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET heartbeat_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + #{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second', row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()

-- 현재 소유자만 고정 실패코드를 확정한다. 세 번째 시도 뒤에는 재예약하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code = CASE WHEN #{retryable} AND attempt_count < 3 THEN 'RETRY_WAIT' ELSE 'FAILED' END, error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN #{retryable} AND attempt_count < 3 THEN clock_timestamp() + ((CASE WHEN attempt_count = 1 THEN 60 ELSE 300 END) + #{jitterSeconds}) * interval '1 second' ELSE NULL END, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()

-- 요청마다 실제 소비할 byte를 단조 증가시켜 재시도로 예산을 초기화하지 못하게 한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs j SET reserved_download_bytes = reserved_download_bytes + #{bytes}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND #{bytes} > 0 AND #{bytes} <= download_budget_bytes - reserved_download_bytes AND
mapper.insert: -- 전역/host 슬롯은 만료 후에만 재할당하며 job 소유권보다 오래 임대하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_resource_leases ( resource_code, resource_key, slot_no, job_id, job_lease_token, resource_lease_token, lease_expires_at ) SELECT #{resourceCode}, #{resourceKey}, #{slotNo}, j.id, j.lease_token, #{resourceLeaseToken}, clock_timestamp() + #{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second' FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.lease_token = #{jobLeaseToken} AND j.job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() + #{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second' AND ON CONFLICT (resource_code, resource_key, slot_no) DO UPDATE SET job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id, job_lease_token = EXCLUDED.job_lease_token, policy_validation_id=NULL, policy_validation_lease_token=NULL, provider_qa_case_id=NULL, provider_qa_lease_token=NULL, resource_lease_token = EXCLUDED.resource_lease_token, lease_expires_at = EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE announcement_attachment_resource_leases.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
